title: Is 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 the Last One for the Apple TV Series? - NewsBreak
text:
By Elisabeth McGowan Courtesy of Apple ,
8 hours ago
Will Coach Lasso return to the field for another season, or is this one the last?
We’re midway through season 4 of Ted Lasso , and fans are already speculating about the show’s future. As viewers already know, it took three years for the beloved soccer (ahem, football) series to return to our screens. And now that most of the gang is back together, people are hoping to see more of their stories unfold.
Hollywood Life has the latest details you need to know about Ted Lasso season 4.
Is Ted Lasso Season 4 the Last One? It’s unclear if season 4 will be the last chapter for Ted Lasso . But, then again, fans assumed the third season was its last, and here we are with a fourth season! So, it’s possible that Apple TV will continue the sports show.
Will There Be a Season 5 of Ted Lasso ? Apple TV has yet to confirm that season 5 is definitive. The decision will ultimately depend on viewership and ratings, but the cast and crew have been optimistic about the future of the show.
According to The Hollywood Reporter , if “all goes according to plan,” the Ted Lasso creative team “will be back in the writers room in late August mapping out a not-yet-ordered season 5. Once again, Sudeikis has a three-season arc in mind, and he’s hopeful that the audience will still be there.”
The Emmy-winning series has been lauded for its tackling of difficult themes, such as anxiety, as well as overwhelmingly positive energy led by Coach Lasso himself.
“It is infectious to play a character who sees the best in people and isn’t mad at the world for all its foibles and bullies and shadows,” Jason Sudeikis previously told THR . “It’s not like I’m Daniel Day-Lewis , but it was good to live in that — to have that coursing through your brain and your body all day.”
Would Jason Sudeikis Come Back for Season 5? Since there’s still not answer on a fifth season, it’s unclear if Sudeikis is coming back. But if season 5 is greenlit, he most likely will return to the field.
After all, during his July 2026 interview with THR , Sudeikis said he “needed” this fourth season to happen. “I needed it as much as other people do,” he added.
